tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Fetch full detail for a single product by its numeric catalogue id or its SKU code.

id.description: Product catalogue id (digits) or SKU code

tools.name: get_store_info
tools.description: Store name, description, website, policy page links (shipping, returns, privacy, terms, FAQ, contact), and the timestamp of the catalogue snapshot.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the store's main (top-level) product categories with their page URLs. Sub-categories are not listed separately; each product's own full category list is returned by search_products and get_product.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the store catalogue by keyword. Every term must appear (AND), matching is case-insensitive substring across product name, SKU, category and description. Returns price, availability, description and the product page URL.

query.description: Search terms, e.g. 'us m1938 tanker goggles'. Up to 8 terms are used.
